gaps.issue: DEL00 Theorem 2.6(ii) is stated for plurisubharmonic functions, whereas the theorem assumes only quasi-plurisubharmonic Γ_τ. The proof omits the necessary local reduction Γ_τ=φ+ρ and the invariance of multiplier ideals under the resulting locally bounded smooth perturbations.

The identification of the componentwise formula with the previously defined raw inverse-system transform explicitly relies on thm:pseff-perturbation-independent-transform, but neither that statement nor the exact definition it compares is supplied in the dependency context. Transition invariance of the displayed ideal values is argued, but the claimed identification with the named global transform remains unverifiable from this packet.

The proof relies essentially on the absent def:mp-general-psh and on unstated ambient facts that X^{bethan} is compact and that rational translation preserves the model psh cone. These premises are not contained in the proposition statement or in any supplied premise card, so the final invocation of the definition and the construction of the directed approximating net cannot be checked under the provided context.

Essential deductions are delegated to undeclared internal results, including the finite-energy bijection, all-point Kähler comparison, order reflection, divisorial finiteness at the trivial semivaluation, endpoint identity, existence and transform formula for decreasing infima, dominated divisorial density, and divisorial inversion. Their exact statements are absent and there are no declared ancestors, so existence of Γ, promotion from divisorial equality to all of X^{bethan}, and uniqueness/order reflection cannot be verified.

The proof depends on absent internal statements for the constant transform, positive-volume recovery and its recovery formula, finite-energy correspondence, maximum/infimum transform formulas, divisorial inversion, dominated divisorial density, and the finite-energy link. Without their exact hypotheses and conclusions, the zero-tail recovery, finite-energy claim, truncation limit, and final order-isomorphism conclusion are unsupported in the supplied context.

The packet assigns incompatible whole-file SHA-256 values to the same named source files: mp_2409.06221v2.txt has 724926… and 0445cc…, dxz_2302.02541v3.txt has 3234b3… and 7d5a06…, and xia_2312.17150v3.txt has a39c27… and c75572…. Thus the simultaneous claims that these are exact extracts from the same full files cannot be authenticated as written.
